description: Returns the fee dataset version, check dates, a staleness warning, hashes, and the source URLs for every platform and card processor. The full result includes the fees-as-of date per platform and processor, the oldest check date, the latest fee changelog entry, and SHA-256 of the embedded fee data and engine. Use it to cite or cache answers, or to check whether fee rows may be stale. Do not use it for price or fee math (use the other tools), for sellers outside the US, for Amazon FBA, for competitor repricing, or for VAT. It takes no inputs. US sellers only. Read-only.
name: data_version
title: Fee data version and sources
